available_evidence_sources.quote: Ultra: read the complete new16,391-byte entropy-witness proof, including the finite calibration, analytic binary witness, convex-dual completeness and single-ergodic-record consistency argument. It preserves the stationary all-even hidden-Markov premises. New bounded entropy payoffs transfer to realised path entropy; the explicit lag-two statistic supplies a cheap receiver without a huge optimization. The hierarchy targets the least hidden dissipation compatible with the full observed ergodic law, not arbitrary invisible excess dissipation or the unknown ensemble mean. Its general finite-at-each-stage enumeration has no useful uniform resource bound.
